title: Your brain is the strangest thing you own
teaser: Count the Fs in one sentence, then meet the column: puzzles that fool your brain and the science of how it learns.

slides.alt: Cover: Your brain is the strangest thing you own. Every week: puzzles that fool it, facts that explain it, and the science of how it learns.
Count the Fs in this sentence: FINISHED FILES ARE THE RESULT OF YEARS OF SCIENTIFIC STUDY COMBINED WITH THE EXPERIENCE OF YEARS.
The answer: six. Missed some? Check every 'of'. Fluent readers skim short, familiar words, and 'of' sounds like it has a v in it.
What's coming: Monday, Can You Solve It?; Wednesday, Brain Glitch; Thursday, Memory Lab; Saturday, Brain Fact or Myth or Fact?; daily, a riddle in Stories.
For teachers and designers: everything here comes with its source, so you can use it.

body: Your brain is the strangest thing you own. It fills gaps you didn't know were there, forgets on schedule, and does some of its best work while you're asleep.
Curiosity Corner is where we explore it: puzzles that fool it, facts that explain it, and the science of how it learns and remembers. Every fact comes with a source.
So, how many Fs did you count? There are six. If you got three, check every 'of': fluent readers skim short, familiar words, and 'of' sounds as though it has a v in it.
